layout: Bi-lingualism. Rows = area of bi-lingualism (district or state x tahsil or zamindari), serial-numbered 1-77, repeated on every page; columns = mother-tongue blocks, each = number of persons speaking the mother-tongue (M/F) followed by subsidiary languages (M/F). No Persons columns printed. Mother-tongue(s) on this page: Gondi.
conventions: subsidiary = null with mt_total = true is the 'Number of persons speaking mother-tongue' column. Pairs printed as '..' / '..' are omitted; where only one of a pair is nil ('..') it is recorded as 0. 'serial' is the printed serial number. area_path ends with the district (or 'Central Provinces States').
